title: Disposal of Land by Development Authorities Regulation First Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Disposal of Land by Development Authorities Regulation First Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

DISPOSAL OF LAND DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITIES
DISPOSAL OF LAND
DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITIES
(REGULATION)
(FIRST AMENDMENT) ORDIANANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XL OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Disposal of Land by Development Authorities (Regulation)
Act, 1998
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 8th August, 2002]
No. Legis.13-30/94(P), dated
8-8-2002.-The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab
is hereby published for general information:
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Disposal of Land by Development
Authorities (Regulation) (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
